headline: Delhi court orders release of Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka after 7 days in Jantar Mantar trespassing case
caption:
Saurav Das Ashutosh Ranka release: Delhi court ne CJP netaon ko 7 din baad choda, par Delhi HC ne kaha "aap Gen Z nahi ho" 👀

- Jantar Mantar mein kathit taur par security todne ke case mein 13 Oct se custody mein the
- SEM court ne kaha: unke conduct se kanoon ke prati respect ki kami dikhti hai, aur "habitualness" in de-notified areas mein protest bulane ki
- Delhi HC ne kaha: barricade ek purpose ke liye hota hai, permission isiliye li jaati hai
- Umar poocha gaya: Das 27, Ranka 32. Court bola: "Then you are not Gen Z"

Barricade todkar protest karna kya sahi hai? Haan ya Na? Comment karo 👇

Fact corrected to match the article: Article says police only sought an extension (3 days); the SEM extended custody by 2 days.
Fact corrected to match the article: Barricade breach is an allegation (HC said they 'allegedly' breached barricades), so it must be attributed, not stated as fact.
